name: Bared Teeth
source:
You and your best friend happen to get lost in the woods. While wandering, the two of you happen upon a mysterious, seemingly abandoned mansion. 

An eccentric man lives there, and you can't help but be wary of him. But, perhaps the one you should fear was the one closest to you all along...?

[From [url=https://chercookue.itch.io/bared-teeth]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你与挚友偶然在树林里迷了路。徘徊之际，你们无意间撞见了一座神秘且看似废弃的洋馆。

那里住着一个性格古怪的男人，你不由得对他心生戒备。然而，或许你真正应该畏惧的，从一开始就是离你最近的那个人……？

[引自[url=https://chercookue.itch.io/bared-teeth]Itch.io[/url]]
